brandStory: Lifan is a Chongqing motorcycle maker whose parent company has been listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 25 November 2010 (stock code 601777). Its motorcycle division runs two brands, LIFAN and PFMOTO, with eight main series and more than 80 models sold in 117 countries and regions. Lifan has also set up motorcycle factories in Vietnam, Thailand and Turkey.

models.name: KPR200
models.tagline: Fully faired 200 cc sports bike with fuel injection and six gears
summary: The Lifan KPR200 is a fully faired sports motorcycle built around a 198 cc water-cooled single with electronic fuel injection. It makes 15.0 kW at 9,000 rpm and 17.5 Nm at 7,500 rpm, drives through a six-speed gearbox, and the maker quotes a top speed of 120 km/h. It suits riders stepping up from a 125 who want sports styling without a big engine.

For the showroom, the figures are friendly: a 770 mm seat, 159 kg kerb weight and a 14 litre tank. Discs at both ends, aluminium alloy wheels and 100/80-17 and 130/70-17 tyres complete the package. The same chassis is offered as the KPR250 with a 250 cc engine rated at 20.5 kW, so one platform can cover two licence and budget levels.

models.name: KP200
models.tagline: Water-cooled 200 cc naked street bike with a 15 litre tank
summary: The Lifan KP200 is a naked street motorcycle powered by a 198 cc water-cooled four-stroke single. Output is 12.5 kW at 8,000 rpm with 17 Nm of torque at 6,500 rpm, fed to a six-speed gearbox with a conventional hand clutch. It is aimed at everyday riders who want a full-size 200 cc bike for commuting with enough pace for open roads.

Its 138 kg net weight and 775 mm seat keep it approachable, while the 15 litre tank and a maker fuel figure of 2.3 L/100 km or less point to long gaps between fill-ups. Discs front and rear, aluminium alloy wheels and a rear tyre of 130/70-17 round it out. The maker quotes a top speed of 110 km/h.

models.name: Starship 6

summary: The Lifan Starship 6 is a full-dress touring motorcycle with a 573 cc water-cooled V-twin, fuel injection and a six-speed gearbox. It makes 39.0 kW at 8,500 rpm and 54.0 Nm at 6,000 rpm, with a quoted top speed of 160 km/h. The maker presents it as its flagship cruiser, aimed at two-up riders covering long distances in comfort. Equipment is the selling point: a 77 GHz radar for blind spot detection, rear collision warning and lane change assist, a dual LED plus TFT dash, a six-channel speaker system, USB and Type-C charging and an electric centre stand. It weighs 325 kg kerb, has a low 745 mm seat, a 20 litre tank, hard cases and a top box.

models.tagline: Step-through cub with automatic clutch, in 110 or 125 cc versions
summary: The Lifan PK110F is a step-through cub motorcycle offered with a 109 cc or 125 cc air-cooled single. A four-speed gearbox with automatic clutch means no clutch lever, which makes it easy for new riders and for stop-start town work. The 110 makes 6.0 kW and 7.8 Nm, the 125 makes 6.6 kW and 8.7 Nm.

It weighs 100 kg kerb, has a 770 mm seat and 17-inch wheels with 2.50-17 and 2.75-17 tyres, in alloy or spoked form. A front disc and rear drum, electric and kick start, and a maker economy figure of 62.5 km/L or better suit delivery and commuting use. The tank holds 3 litres.

models.name: KPV350
models.tagline: Water-cooled 350 cc maxi scooter with fuel injection and twin discs
summary: The Lifan KPV350 is a maxi scooter powered by a 349.9 cc water-cooled single with electronic fuel injection and a CVT automatic transmission. It makes 25.5 kW at 7,500 rpm and 35.5 Nm at 6,000 rpm, enough for a quoted top speed of 135 km/h. It suits commuters who ride on fast roads and want scooter convenience with motorway-capable pace.

It uses 15-inch front and 14-inch rear alloy wheels with 120/70-15 and 140/70-14 tyres, and discs front and rear. The 780 mm seat, 1520 mm wheelbase and 15.5 litre tank suit longer trips, and the scooter weighs 186 kg net. The maker economy figure is 25.0 km/L or better.

models.name: KPV PLUS
models.tagline: Adventure-styled 150 cc scooter with water cooling and twin discs
summary: The Lifan KPV PLUS is an adventure-styled scooter with a tall screen, powered by a 149.8 cc water-cooled single and a CVT automatic. It produces 11.1 kW at 8,500 rpm and 13.1 Nm at 6,500 rpm, strong figures for a 150 cc scooter, and the maker quotes a top speed of 105 km/h. It suits urban riders who want rugged styling with learner-friendly capacity.

It runs 14-inch aluminium alloy wheels with 100/80-14 and 120/70-14 tyres and has disc brakes at both ends, plus a 1320 mm wheelbase. The seat is 770 mm high, the tank holds 11 litres and the scooter weighs 152 kg net. The maker fuel figure is 2.4 L/100 km or less.

models.name: LANCE150
models.tagline: Sporty 150 cc scooter with water cooling and fuel injection
summary: The Lifan LANCE150 is a sporty urban scooter powered by a 149.3 cc water-cooled single with electronic fuel injection and a CVT automatic. It produces 9.0 kW at 8,500 rpm and 11.8 Nm at 5,500 rpm, with a quoted top speed of at least 93 km/h. It suits commuters and younger riders who want sharp styling in a manageable 150.

At 125 kg net and 690 mm wide it is slim enough for city traffic, with a 778 mm seat and 14-inch alloy wheels on 100/80-14 and 120/70-14 tyres. Braking is disc and disc, or disc and drum, depending on version. The tank holds 7 litres and the maker figure is 41.7 km/L or better.

models.name: Blossoms150
models.tagline: Retro-styled 150 cc small-wheel model with a five-speed gearbox
summary: The Lifan Blossoms150 is a retro-styled small-wheel model with scooter bodywork and a 149.3 cc oil-cooled single fed by a carburettor. Unlike most scooters it uses a five-speed gearbox with a left-foot shift, according to the maker. It makes 8.6 kW at 7,500 rpm and 12 Nm at 6,000 rpm, and suits style-conscious town riders.

At 105 kg kerb with a 765 mm seat and a 1280 mm wheelbase, it is light and easy to manoeuvre. It runs a 12-inch front and 10-inch rear wheel with 90/90-12 and 3.5-10 tyres, a front disc and rear drum, and both electric and kick start. The tank holds 5.5 litres and the maker figure is 50 km/L or better.
